Cell QC of the caller

Source: R/features.R
cell_qc.Rd

A cell passes when it has at least min_frag clean fragments, a fraction of MAPQ-60 fragments of at least min_mapq60 and at most max_chrM chrM fragments. Clean fragments are n_clean, falling back to n_pass and then n_frag. A QC column that is missing from the cell table is not applied; an NA value fails the cell (qc_pass == TRUE is required), except NA frac_chrM, which passes.

Usage

cell_qc(
  scn,
  min_frag = 5000,
  min_mapq60 = 0.5,
  max_chrM = 0.2,
  params = caller_defaults()
)

Arguments

scn

scn object (uses scn$cells) or a cell table

min_frag

minimal clean fragments

min_mapq60

minimal fraction of MAPQ-60 fragments

max_chrM

maximal fraction of chrM fragments

params

caller_defaults() (depth strata)

Value

data.table cell, qc_pass, stratum, n_frag
